description: This Python module provides a storage service wrapper for robot test management. It includes functions for generating storage paths, saving robot files and run artifacts, retrieving files, and obtaining presigned URLs for run artifacts.

methods.name: str generate_unique_storage_path(test_file_id: int, filename: str, add_uuid: bool = False)
methods.description: Generates a storage path for a robot test file, optionally adding a UUID for uniqueness.

methods.name: str save_robot_file(file_data: bytes, test_file_id: int, filename: str)
methods.description: Saves a robot test file to storage, returning its storage path.

methods.name: str save_run_artifact(file_path: str, run_id: int, artifact_type: str)
methods.description: Saves a run artifact (log, output, report) to storage and returns its path.

methods.name: bytes get_robot_file(storage_path: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a robot test file from storage as bytes.

methods.name: dict get_run_logs(run_id: int)
methods.description: Provides presigned URLs for a run's log, output, and report artifacts.
